title: Employees' State Insurance — Registration & Monthly Filing
version: ESI Act 1948 (paraphrased; verify current state-wise notifications)
notes: 10-employee threshold is the commonly cited current figure for most states/UTs after being reduced from 20; a few states/establishment types may still apply a different threshold -- verify against the applicable state ESIC notification. Monthly contribution due date (commonly cited as the 15th of the following month) should be verified on esic.gov.in.
